description: This file implements a Promise class following the Promises/A+ specification, providing asynchronous programming capabilities. It defines methods for then, catch, resolve, reject, and cancel, and manages promise states and handlers.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: Implementation of a Promise conforming to Promises/A+ spec, managing asynchronous resolution, rejection, cancellation, and chaining.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Creates a new Promise instance with optional wait and cancel functions.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is resolved or rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', or 'rejected').

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel function if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with the given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with the given reason.
